contentText:
Peso Pluma and Eslabon Armado’s “Amigos Con Derechos” debuts in the top 10 of the Hot Latin Songs, but will it take over the No. 1 spot?

Narrator: Here’s the Billboard Hot Latin Songs top 10 for the week dated July 11! “De Lejitos” slips to No. 10, “Daño” descends to No. 9. “Koko” is locked at No. 8. Eslabon Armado and Peso Pluma debut at No. 7. “Voy a Llevarte Pa PR” falls to No. 6. “Ayúdame” reaches the top five. “Eoo” stays at No. 4. “Nuevayol” presses on at No. 3. “Baile Inolvidable” holds its ground at No. 2. And “DTMF” marks a 67th week at No. 1!
